title: Decree of the Ministry of the Environment on the Fire Safety of Buildings (848/2017)
quote: Asuntojen, majoitustilojen, hoitolaitosten, päivähoitolaitosten, päiväkotien ja muiden varhaiskasvatuksen tilojen sekä koulujen on oltava varustettu tarkoituksenmukaisella laitteistolla, joka varhaisessa vaiheessa ilmoittaa alkavasta palosta.
quote_translation: Dwellings, accommodation premises, care institutions, day-care institutions, day-care centres and other early childhood education premises, and schools must be equipped with an appropriate device that gives warning of an incipient fire at an early stage. (our translation)

table.name: Taulukko 12. Tiloissa edellytetyt palosta ilmoittavat laitteistot, row 'Koulut'

rows.en: up to 250 pupils: mains-connected smoke alarm
over 500 pupils: fire alarm system connected to the emergency response centre

scope_note: The decree requires the school to HAVE an appropriate early-warning device and says which kind. It does not list the rooms. The room-by-room check (a detector in every room) applies the decree's word 'tarkoituksenmukainen' (appropriate) as full coverage, which is how detection systems are laid out in practice; the placement standard itself is not quoted here.

title: Building Bulletin 103: Area guidelines for mainstream schools (Department for Education)
clause: Part A, Basic teaching area: classrooms, and Area Data Sheet CLA12
quote: CLA12 C General classroom: For a range of FF&E layout options and activities 55m2 for 30
quote_2: typically, standard classrooms in zone C (55m2 to 62m2 for 30 pupils) [...] semi-open classbases in zone B (50m2 to 55m2 for 30 pupils) which are restrictive
scope_note: Guidance, not law: the document calls itself 'simple, non-statutory area guidelines'. It is written for mainstream schools; the sample plan is a special school, for which Building Bulletin 104 recommends larger rooms for smaller groups, so this check is the lenient one.

title: Decree of the Ministry of the Environment on the Indoor Climate and Ventilation of New Buildings (1009/2017)
quote: Oleskelutilojen ulkoilmavirraksi on mitoitettava vähintään 6 dm³/s henkilöä kohti suunniteltuna käyttöaikana, jos tilan käyttötarkoituksesta ei aiheudu lisäilmavirran tarvetta.
quote_translation: The outdoor air flow of occupied spaces must be designed to be at least 6 dm³/s per person during the designed period of use, unless the use of the space requires additional air flow. (our translation)
scope_note: The required air flow follows from the number of people the room is furnished for. Whether the ventilation delivers it cannot be read from an architectural plan; the check reports the required flow and marks the rule as not checked.
